brief: Fifty more Codealong logo candidates expanding C/CA construction, movement, material and metaphor.

concepts.name: Aperture
concepts.idea: A crisp opening reveals a second shape.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE original logo candidate for Codealong, a Mac app that keeps track of multiple coding agents and sessions across projects. Core idea: capable companionship, clear attention, and independent work brought together.
Output: one centered finished symbol on a square, fully opaque canvas, with even 15% margins. Large, exceptionally simple silhouette and intentional negative space, recognizable at app-icon size. No words, captions, candidate numbers, watermark, UI, devices, or contact sheet. No imitation of existing company logos. Follow the specific construction and palette below; use clean off-white background unless another background is specified.

Specific direction: A single bold midnight-blue squared C carved from a solid rounded square. An ivory wedge cuts into its right side and widens into a perfectly circular interior. One tiny orange rectangular inset sits in the lower inside corner. Entirely flat vector-like design, precise geometry, no gradients or shadows.

Create ONE original logo candidate for Codealong, a Mac app that keeps track of multiple coding agents and sessions across projects. Core idea: capable companionship, clear attention, and independent work brought together.
Output: one centered finished symbol on a square, fully opaque canvas, with even 15% margins. Large, exceptionally simple silhouette and intentional negative space, recognizable at app-icon size. No words, captions, candidate numbers, watermark, UI, devices, or contact sheet. No imitation of existing company logos. Follow the specific construction and palette below; use clean off-white background unless another background is specified.

Specific direction: A beautiful solid pale-blue rounded-square ceramic token with a bold C deeply debossed into the face; the inner groove is cobalt and contains one small orange square at its lower end. Front view with subtle thickness, material depth kept restrained, isolated on warm white. No text or extra symbols.
